description: A front-end webpage implementing a database visualizer interface, including UI layout, styling, and client-side logic for fetching and displaying database information and table data dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and updates the sidebar with database items.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets current selections, and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the display of tables for a selected database and initiates loading of table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a specified database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders it in the content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying data in a tabular format.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual table cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long or object data on click.
